title: Edit Portability Map
user: Photographers leaving Lightroom or using a read-only external library who need to know exactly which edits, dates, ratings, and metadata will travel safely.
smallest_useful_product: Read-only desktop CLI that inventories a Lightroom catalog/XMP and a target folder, classifies fields as embedded, sidecar, catalog-only, or target-unsupported, and produces a migration checklist and verification sample.
success_measure: A user can inventory 95% of visible metadata/edit categories before migration and identify every catalog-only field in under 15 minutes.
constraints: Read-only catalog access; proprietary edit recipes cannot be faithfully translated; do not ingest image pixels or cloud credentials.
